title: Let's Learn English Lesson 39
subtitle: It's Unbelievable!
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 39: It's Unbelievable! (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! Winter weather in Washington, D.C. can be really windy. And wind messes up my hair. It is really windy today. Look at my hair. Will it be windy this weekend? I'll listen to the news. I am tired of my untidy hair.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！華盛頓特區的冬天可能很颳風。風還會弄亂我的頭髮。今天風真大。看看我的頭髮。這個週末會颳風嗎？我要聽新聞。我厭倦了亂糟糟的頭髮。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Are you tired of your untidy hair?
dialogue.zh: 你厭倦亂糟糟的頭髮了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. Yes, I am. And it's ... uncomfortable.
dialogue.zh: 是的。是的，我厭倦了。而且……不舒服。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Is it ... uncomfortable?
dialogue.zh: 它……不舒服嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. Yes, it is! Hey, is that ... Pete?
dialogue.zh: 是的。是的，不舒服！嘿，那是……皮特嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Hi. I'm Pete. And I have the perfect product for you -- Hair Be Good!
dialogue.zh: 嗨。我是皮特。我有最適合你的產品——Hair Be Good！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Just spray Hair Be Good on your hair ... wrap in a towel ... and you are done! Hair Be Good works and it's inexpensive. One can costs only $10! So, go online and order your Hair Be Good today!
dialogue.zh: 只要把 Hair Be Good 噴在頭髮上……用毛巾包起來……就完成了！Hair Be Good 有效，而且不貴。一罐只要 10 美元！所以，今天就上網訂購你的 Hair Be Good 吧！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hair Be Good sounds perfect! And I can trust Pete! I am buying some right now. Okay, I will order one can of Hair Be Good for $10. I'll pay with a credit card. My delivery will arrive in 2 days. Awesome!
dialogue.zh: Hair Be Good 聽起來很完美！而且我可以信任皮特！我現在就買。好，我要訂一罐 10 美元的 Hair Be Good。我用信用卡付款。貨會在 2 天內到。太棒了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It arrived! I'll use it before I go to work. Okay, Hair Be Good, make my untidy hair tidy! No, make it ... fabulous!
dialogue.zh: 到了！我上班前先用。好，Hair Be Good，讓我亂糟糟的頭髮變整齊！不，讓它……美極了！

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, Amelia!
dialogue.zh: 你好，阿梅莉亞！

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Anna, you look ... different.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你看起來……不一樣。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks! I used a new product called Hair Be Good.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！我用了一種新產品，叫 Hair Be Good。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Well, it's not.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，它並不。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It's not what?
dialogue.zh: 並不什麼？

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Good. Your hair does not look good.
dialogue.zh: 好。你的頭髮看起來不好。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, no! This is not good.
dialogue.zh: 哦，不！這可不好。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Why don't you go home and take care of ... this.
dialogue.zh: 你為什麼不回家處理一下……這個。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Good idea.
dialogue.zh: 好主意。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, Pete.
dialogue.zh: 你好，皮特。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Is something wrong?
dialogue.zh: 出什麼事了？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is wrong!
dialogue.zh: 這就有問題！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: What did you do to your hair?
dialogue.zh: 你對頭髮做了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hair Be Good did this to my hair.
dialogue.zh: 是 Hair Be Good 把我的頭髮弄成這樣的。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Ah, you bought it!
dialogue.zh: 啊，你買了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, I bought it. You said in your ad it was a perfect product. This is not perfect. This is imperfect!
dialogue.zh: 是的，我買了。你在廣告裡說它是完美產品。這不完美。這是不完美的！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: It's unbelievable!
dialogue.zh: 這難以置信！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I believed your ad, Pete. It was dishonest!
dialogue.zh: 我相信了你的廣告，皮特。它不誠實！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Anna, you don't believe everything you see in ads, do you?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你不會相信廣告裡看到的一切，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, Pete. Just the ones with my friends.
dialogue.zh: 不會，皮特。只相信有我朋友的那些。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Your hair will be okay. Just wash it ... a couple of times.
dialogue.zh: 你的頭髮會沒事的。只要洗一洗……洗幾次。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks. Thanks a lot, Pete! Here, here's your product! You should call it "Hair Be Really, Really Bad!" Until next time, Pete! Till next time.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。非常感謝，皮特！給，這是你的產品！你該叫它“頭髮真的、真的很糟”！下次見，皮特！下次見。

quiz.prompt: How much does one can cost?
What does Anna say about Pete's ad?
